schemaNote: Supplemental user-request contract, not a numbered GitHub issue; no issue number is fabricated. Criterion fields follow the acceptance-contract schema.
liveProofRequiredSeparately: apps/web/tests/web-host/web-host-approvals.spec.ts must cover matrix rows 72-75 and actual engine continuation; these HTTP tests do not start an engine or claim live UI proof.

transport.list: GET /web/approvals?status=pending returns a pending-card array with decisionMode trusted-tailnet-web, sessionId, display fields, revision and cardHash; no raw nonce or signing material
transport.decision: PATCH /web/approvals/:id accepts exactly status, revision and cardHash

serverAudit.binding: decision, revision and cardHash from the transactionally revalidated card

criteria.text: Web-mode bootstrap advertises approvals; the API works without bearer or signing material and returns exact pending card fields.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c01: tokenless web capability lists exact pending cards without signing material

criteria.text: List and decision exclude foreign, NULL-owner and sessionless cards without changing ownership.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c02: foreign, ownerless and sessionless cards are neither listed nor decidable

criteria.text: Changed displayed or execution fields and rotated nonces invalidate the old card revision or hash without mutating its decision state.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c03: changed display, execution bindings and nonce refuse a stale card without mutation

criteria.text: Explicit, fallback and malformed expiry refuse Approve with 403 while the original nonce and unconsumed pending state remain intact.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c04: expired and malformed cards refuse Approve with 403 and retain their nonce unconsumed

criteria.text: Concurrent, duplicate and opposite decisions persist exactly one decision and consume the nonce once.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c05: concurrent decisions persist one result and replay or opposite decisions cannot consume twice

criteria.text: Unknown request keys fail; owner and honest trusted-tailnet-web provenance are authored by the server and persisted exactly as returned.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c06: exact body keys and server-authored trusted-tailnet-web receipt prevent provenance spoofing

criteria.text: The real signed consumption route accepts an unchanged web-approved security card once and rejects a changed card or receipt without consumption.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c07: downstream signed consumption accepts an unchanged web receipt once and rejects changed cards or receipts

criteria.text: Host and Origin guards reject foreign requests, the adapter is absent outside web mode, and signed desktop and Hermes authority remain intact.
criteria.test_id: web-approvals-2c-c08: Host/Origin guards, web-off absence and existing native/Hermes authority remain intact
